name: Mirroring
description: Repeat the last 1-3 words to build rapport and encourage elaboration
when_use: Early to establish rapport and dig deeper into pain points

templates.pattern: {{LAST_WORDS}}?
templates.context: Simple mirroring - repeat their last words

templates.pattern: You said {{LAST_WORDS}}... tell me more about that.

triggers.regex: challenge|problem|difficult|struggle|see value but|want.*but|interested but|executives want|team wants|middle management|status quo|budget constraint|timing|approval|decision maker

LAST_WORDS.prompt: Extract the last 1-3 words from the prospect's statement

name: Empathy Response
description: Understand and articulate emotions to make them feel heard
when_use: When you want emotional bonding or to soften resistance

templates.pattern: It sounds like {{EMOTION}} is really affecting {{SITUATION}}. That must be frustrating.
I can see why {{EMOTION}} would be a concern when dealing with {{SITUATION}}.

EMOTION.prompt: Extract the emotion word (frustrated, worried, concerned, etc.) - single word only

SITUATION.prompt: Extract what they're dealing with (2-4 words, e.g., 'current software', 'team productivity')

name: Empathy Questions
description: Acknowledge past efforts while opening discussion to improvements
when_use: When prospect justifies current solution and you want to guide them to better solution

templates.pattern: I appreciate that {{CURRENT_EFFORT}} has been working. What would make it even better?
templates.context: Validate current approach while seeking improvement

templates.pattern: {{CURRENT_EFFORT}} sounds solid. If you could wave a magic wand and improve one thing about it, what would that be?
templates.context: Magic wand question to uncover hidden desires

CURRENT_EFFORT.prompt: Extract their current solution/effort (2-5 words, e.g., 'spreadsheet system', 'weekly meetings')

name: Summarizing
description: Rephrase what they said in your own words
when_use: When you're not sure if you understand their viewpoint

templates.pattern: Let me make sure I understand - you're saying {{SUMMARY}}. Is that right?
So if I'm hearing you correctly, {{SUMMARY}}. Did I get that right?

SUMMARY.prompt: Summarize their key point in 5-15 words using your own words (not verbatim)
SUMMARY.fallback: there are multiple challenges to address

name: Labeling
description: Name the emotions you observe to diffuse tension
when_use: When you feel tension building or negative emotions

templates.pattern: It seems like {{EMOTION_LABEL}}.
It sounds like {{EMOTION_LABEL}} - is that what you're experiencing?

EMOTION_LABEL.prompt: Extract the emotion being felt (e.g., 'you're frustrated with the timeline', 'this feels uncertain')

name: Calibrated Questions
description: Ask open-ended 'how' or 'what' questions to shift control
when_use: When you want prospect to be more active in collaborating

templates.pattern: How would {{DESIRED_OUTCOME}} impact {{THEIR_SITUATION}}?
What would need to happen for {{GOAL}} to become a reality?
templates.context: Get them to think through implementation

templates.pattern: How do you see {{SOLUTION}} fitting into {{THEIR_SITUATION}}?

triggers.regex: not sure|don't know|uncertain|maybe|thinking|how would|how do|what would|tell me more

DESIRED_OUTCOME.prompt: Extract desired outcome (2-5 words, e.g., 'saving time', 'reducing costs')

THEIR_SITUATION.prompt: Extract their situation (2-5 words, e.g., 'your team', 'daily operations')

SOLUTION.prompt: Extract the solution being discussed (2-5 words)

name: Negative Assumption
description: Address potential objections upfront to disarm them
when_use: As soon as you suspect they have a concern or objection

templates.pattern: You're probably thinking {{OBJECTION}} - and that's a fair concern. Let's talk about that.
I bet you're wondering if {{CONCERN}}. That's actually something we should address directly.

OBJECTION.prompt: Extract likely objection (3-7 words, e.g., 'this is too expensive', 'we don't have time')
OBJECTION.fallback: this might not work for us

CONCERN.prompt: Extract the concern as a question (5-10 words, e.g., 'this will actually save time')

name: Dynamic Silence
description: Use pauses to encourage them to fill silence with information
when_use: In later stages when you want prospect to tell more

templates.pattern: [Pause] ... {{LAST_POINT}}... [Wait for them to continue]
Mmm... [Pause to let them elaborate]

LAST_POINT.prompt: Extract their last key point (2-4 words)

name: Black Swan
description: Uncover hidden issues, problems, and desires
when_use: When progress stalls or they seem reluctant

templates.pattern: What's the biggest challenge that {{STAKEHOLDER}} doesn't want to talk about?
What would make this a bad idea from {{PERSPECTIVE}} perspective?
What do you know about {{TOPIC}} that I don't know?

STAKEHOLDER.prompt: Extract stakeholder reference (1-3 words, e.g., 'your team', 'leadership', 'finance')

name: Buy-In
description: Ask permission before engaging to make them teachable
when_use: When you want their focus or them to be open to new ideas

templates.pattern: Would it be helpful if I shared {{WHAT_TO_SHARE}}?
Can I take a minute to walk you through {{TOPIC}}?
Is now a good time to discuss {{SUBJECT}}?

triggers.regex: interest|curious|want to know|tell me|explain|promising|could help|sounds good|like this|i like

WHAT_TO_SHARE.prompt: Extract what you want to share (3-7 words, e.g., 'how others solved this', 'our approach to this')

name: DJ Voice
description: Use deep, calm, slower voice when emotions rise
when_use: When emotions rise and fears are building

templates.pattern: [Slow down, deepen voice] I understand this is {{EMOTION_SITUATION}}. Let's take a moment here.
[Calm, measured tone] {{ACKNOWLEDGMENT}}. We don't need to rush this.

EMOTION_SITUATION.prompt: Extract emotional situation (3-6 words, e.g., 'a big decision', 'causing stress')

ACKNOWLEDGMENT.prompt: Extract what to acknowledge (3-7 words, e.g., 'this is a significant investment')

name: Truth with No
description: Ask questions answered with 'no' but meaning agreement
when_use: To discover truth or uncover real concerns

templates.pattern: Is it a ridiculous idea to {{PROPOSITION}}?
Would it be terrible if {{OUTCOME}}?
templates.context: Get them to defend positive outcome

templates.pattern: Do you want to {{UNDESIRABLE_ACTION}}?

PROPOSITION.prompt: Extract proposition (3-8 words, e.g., 'invest in improving this process')

OUTCOME.prompt: Extract desired outcome (3-7 words, e.g., 'we could save 10 hours weekly')

UNDESIRABLE_ACTION.prompt: Extract undesirable action (3-7 words, e.g., 'keep struggling with current system')

name: Take Away
description: Agree with objection and amplify it to remove pressure
when_use: When objections arise or emotions seem extraordinary

templates.pattern: You're right - if {{OBJECTION}} then we shouldn't move forward. What about {{CONCERN}} concerns you most?
That makes sense. {{OBJECTION}} is a valid reason not to proceed. Help me understand what specifically worries you.
Fair point about {{CONCERN}}. Maybe this isn't the right fit. What would need to change for it to make sense?

OBJECTION.prompt: Extract objection phrase (2-5 words, e.g., 'cost is too high', 'timing isn't right')
